parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).

parameters.name: ContainerGroupId
parameters.description: The ECI instance ID, which is also the container group ID.

parameters.name: Force
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to forcefully clean up resources. Valid values:
- true: Forcefully cleans up resources without waiting for the graceful termination timeout period to expire.
- false (default): Cleans up resources after the graceful termination timeout period expires.
